item.title: Escambia County (AL) Woman Charged with Murder in Shooting Death Of 27-Year-Old Woman
item.description: An Escambia County, Alabama, woman has been charged with murdering another woman late last week. Renotta Seltzer was booked into the Escambia County (AL)Detention Center charged with the shooting death of 27-year-old Anna Brown on McGougin Road near Brewton. Additional details have not been released as the Escambia County (AL) Sheriff’s Office investigation continues.
